profile.summary: ASCEND is a free, tuition-free public charter school in Oakland, California, serving students in transitional kindergarten through 8th grade (ages 4 to 13). It is part of the Education for Change Public Schools network and is authorized by the Oakland Unified School District.

sources.title: Renewal Archive - Oakland Unified School District

review.notes: The school's site confirms the name, TK-8 grades, tuition-free status, address, phone and Education for Change affiliation. The OUSD renewal archive lists ASCEND (TK-8) as an OUSD-authorized charter school, which fits a Prop 39 facilities agreement handled by the Charter School Office. The summary is neutral and the profile contains only business contact details.
